metadata.title: Overseas GEO Intake
metadata.description: Fill in your overseas GEO optimization requirements via the exclusive link from your project consultant.

needLink.revokedDescription: This invite link has been revoked by your project consultant and can no longer be used. Please contact your GEO consultant for a new exclusive link.
needLink.invalidDescription: You have not entered via the exclusive link from your consultant. Please open the /c/… link from your email or Lark message before filling in the form.
needLink.noAccessDescription: Client intake is not open to the public. Please use the exclusive link (/c/…) sent by your project consultant via Lark or email. Do not visit other URLs on this domain directly.
needLink.staffLogin: sign in to the internal portal

form.heroDescription: To better understand your business and optimization needs, please fill in the information below. Fields marked with <asterisk>*</asterisk> are required; others can be completed later with your consultant.

brand.title: Brand & product info
brand.desc: Brand, scope, target users, products, and website details

geo.title: GEO optimization requirements
geo.desc: Target regions, platforms, background, user questions, and goals

contactInfo.label: 2. Contact information
contactInfo.hint: Name, title, and phone number of your primary contact.

brandName.label: 3. Brand to optimize
brandName.hint: The brand you want to improve visibility and recommendations for in ChatGPT. Add aliases if applicable.

brandAliases.hint: Brand aliases (optional): other names for the same brand, e.g. alias "Acme Corp" for "Acme".

scopeType.label: 4. Optimization scope
scopeType.hint: Select what you want to optimize in this project.
scopeType.brandOnlyDesc: Optimize the brand name as a whole

product.label: Describe the product or service
product.hint: Add one or more products/services. Each needs a name plus function, audience, and use cases.

hasOverseasSite.label: 6. Do you have an overseas official website?

overseasSiteUrl.label: Overseas website URL
overseasSiteUrl.hint: Enter the full URL of your overseas website.
overseasSiteUrl.privacyNote: For brand confidentiality, URLs are stored and displayed in a masked format.

targetCustomer.label: 5. Core target users
targetCustomer.hint: Select the primary target user type of your brand.
targetCustomer.tocDesc: Individual consumers: the brand mainly serves everyday consumers in personal purchase scenarios
targetCustomer.tobDesc: Business/institutional customers: the brand mainly serves companies, institutions and organizations
targetCustomer.bothDesc: Both types: covers individual consumers as well as businesses and institutional customers

regions.label: 7. Target countries & languages
regions.hint: Search and select country–language pairs. You can add multiple, e.g. United States – English; United Kingdom – English.

platforms.label: 8. AI platforms to optimize
platforms.hint: Select the AI platforms to optimize. Currently only ChatGPT is supported.

optimizeBackground.label: 9. Optimization background
optimizeBackground.hint: Helps us align timing and approach. Optional.
optimizeBackground.placeholder: Any marketing plans or timelines? Feel free to describe.

intent.label: 10. What questions should users ask to see your brand?
intent.hint: Required — choose one option and fill in at least one item.
intent.clearDesc: Pick a product per row; one question per line. Press Enter to add another.
intent.roughDesc: List directions by priority (Top 1 = highest). Pick a product; press Enter to add another.

goal.label: 11. Optimization goal
goal.hint: Choose the primary KPI for this project (pick one). Final targets will be confirmed in the SOW.

validation.product: For each product/service, fill in the name and complete function, audience, and use cases
validation.hasOverseasSite: Please indicate whether you have an overseas website
validation.overseasSiteUrlInvalid: Please enter a valid URL (including http/https)
validation.regions: Please add at least one complete country-language pair
validation.platforms: Please select at least one AI platform
validation.intent: Please choose specific questions or a general direction, and fill in at least one item

toast.draftSavedDesc: You can return later to continue.
toast.draftSaveFailedDesc: Your browser could not store the draft. Check storage space or privacy settings.
toast.incompleteDesc: Please review highlighted fields before submitting.
toast.alreadySubmittedDesc: Request code {code}. No need to submit again.

success.title: Submitted successfully
success.description: Thank you! Our team will reach out soon to begin GEO assessment, intent discovery, and proposal preparation.
success.codeHint: Save this ID for future reference with your consultant.

errors.missingInvite: Please access via the exclusive link from your sales contact before submitting

formBits.productNamePlaceholder: Product or service name, e.g. AI image generator
formBits.productFnPlaceholder: Function, e.g. AI design tool that generates marketing posters in one click
formBits.productUsersPlaceholder: Target users, e.g. SMB e-commerce sellers, creators, designers
formBits.productScenarioPlaceholder: Use cases, e.g. product images, social posts, ad creatives
formBits.productCompetitorsPlaceholder: Main competitors, e.g. Canva, Figma, Adobe Express

intentClear.placeholder0: e.g. Which AI tool is best for making posters?
intentClear.hint: Press Enter to add another question, Shift+Enter for a line break
intentClear.emptyHint: Fill in product names above, then select a product and describe the user question.

intentRough.priorityHint: List business directions by priority (Top 1 = highest).
intentRough.placeholder0: e.g. When users ask about AI poster design, product images, or AI design tool recommendations, we want our brand to appear
intentRough.hint: Press Enter to add another direction, Shift+Enter for a line break
intentRough.emptyHint: Fill in product names above, then select a product and describe the business direction.

source.label: Source rate
source.desc: Share of AI answers citing your brand site/content as a source

recommend.label: Recommendation rate
recommend.desc: Share of AI answers that mention or recommend your brand

top3.label: Top-3 recommendation rate
top3.desc: Share of answers where your brand appears in the top 3 recommendations

priority.label: Primary recommendation rate
priority.desc: Share of answers where your brand is the first recommendation
